_notes: One entry per ship directory in src/uqm/ships. Values are the RACE_DESC initialiser of each ship, as compiled.
fleet.strength and fleet.home_x/home_y are the starting size and centre of the race's sphere of influence (FLEET_STUFF), in universe units; strength 0 means no sphere.
Waits are in battle frames (24 per second, BATTLE_FRAME_RATE). Speeds and distances are in world units; DISPLAY_TO_WORLD (x) is x << 2 (units.h).

defines lists every integer #define in the ship's source file, including weapon speed, life, damage and range, which are not stored in RACE_DESC. Behaviour (weapons, specials, AI) stays code and is ported by hand.
species is the SPECIES_ID that loads this ship (code_resources in loadship.c).
flags are SHIP_INFO.ship_flags by name; flag_values gives each name's bit (races.h).

graphics are the content resource ids the RACE_DESC names (DATA_STUFF and SHIP_INFO), null for NULL_RESOURCE: ship, weapon and special at the three zooms (ship_rsc, weapon_rsc, special_rsc: big, medium, small; load_animation reuses the size before for a null one), the captain's window (captain_rsc), the status panel's icons (icons_rsc) and Super Melee's icon (melee_icon_rsc). The flagship's are sis_desc's, as init_sis starts from them outside hyperspace.
